description: Na₃SmTi₂Nb₂O₁₂ is Orthorhombic Perovskite-derived structured and crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pmc2₁ space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.38-2.96 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.43-2.72 Å. Sm is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Sm-O bond distances ranging from 2.40-2.56 Å. Ti is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted TiO₆ octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NbO₆ octahedra and corners with five equivalent TiO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 25-29°. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.85-2.22 Å. Nb is bonded to six O atoms to form NbO₆ octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one TiO₆ octahedra and corners with five equivalent NbO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 21-29°. There are a spread of Nb-O bond distances ranging from 1.91-2.11 Å. There are seven inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na and two equivalent Nb atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Sm and two equivalent Ti atoms to form distorted corner-sharing OSm₂Ti₂ tetrahedra. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and two equivalent Nb atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na and two equivalent Nb atoms. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Sm, and two equivalent Ti atoms. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three equivalent Na, one Ti, and one Nb atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to one Na, two equivalent Sm, and two equivalent Ti atoms.
